 Anker 11.11 Sale Offers Up to 20% Off Charging, soundcore, and eufy Products
 by Ian Fuentes 
 - November 10, 2026 
 Anker Philippines is offering up to 20% off select products this November 11 as part of its 11.11 sale. The promotion covers Anker Charging, Anker soundcore, and Anker eufy products, with exclusive freebies and special bundle deals available across its official e-commerce stores.
 Under its “The More, The Merrier with Anker” campaign, shoppers can find discounted charging accessories, audio devices, and smart home cleaning solutions ahead of the Christmas season.
 Anker Charging Deals 
 The Anker Nano Charger is available for Php 1,195, down from its original SRP of Php 1,995. It features an intelligent display that identifies an iPhone for a more personalized charging experience.
 Meanwhile, the Anker MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro is priced at Php 5,995. It features advanced cooling technology designed to help manage heat during charging.
 Shoppers can also get an Anker Nano Charger (20W) and additional discounts when purchasing select Anker Charging products.
 Anker soundcore Offers
 Anker soundcore is also offering discounts on select audio products this 11.11. The Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro is available for Php 8,995, down from Php 9,995. It features Active Noise Cancellation for an immersive listening experience.
 The Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Max, which offers premium audio and an integrated display screen, is priced at Php 10,995 from its original SRP of Php 12,995.
 For those who prefer open-ear audio, the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 is available for Php 9,995. It features an open-ear design, clear call quality, and the ability to stay aware of surrounding sounds. Every purchase also comes with a FREE Sports Backpack.
 Additional discounts are available when purchasing an Anker product alongside select Anker soundcore products.
 Anker eufy Robot Vacuum Deals
 Anker eufy is offering discounts on its smart home cleaning solutions. The Anker eufy Robot Vacuum 3-in-1 E20 is available for Php 15,995, down from its original SRP of Php 18,995. The purchase also includes a dust bag.
 The Anker eufy Robot Vacuum Omni C20 is priced at Php 17,995, down from Php 19,995. Buyers will also receive a FREE accessory bundle that includes two packs of Omni C20 mop cloths, two packs of washable filters, one rolling brush, one brush guard with comb, and one birdy knife.
 Additional discounts are also available when purchasing an Anker product alongside select Anker eufy products.
 Anker 11.11 Sale Schedule
 The Anker 11.11 deals are available through its official stores on Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Lazada. Shopee's sale runs until November 11, 2026, while TikTok Shop offers the deals until November 12. Lazada shoppers can enjoy the promotion until November 13, 2026.
 With discounts of up to 20%, exclusive freebies, and bundle offers, Anker Philippines' 11.11 sale provides shoppers with an opportunity to purchase charging accessories, audio products, and smart home devices ahead of the holiday season.
